Ava (CS): Quick heads-up - I drafted a short day0->day7 customer-facing checklist for onboarding (focus: caching/batching/streaming + renewal signal capture). Sharing here for feedback before we push to the enablement repo.

Diego (Eng): +1. Can you paste the TL;DR config we give customers for safe defaults?

Ava (CS): TL;DR: 1) Enable prefix prefetch for top 5 queries (TTL 300s) 2) Start with batch_size=8, max_latency_ms=60 3) Stream responses for UX flows where partial result helps conversion 4) Add simple fallback: model_variant: small in policy if latency > 400ms 5) Instrument renewal flags (trial_usage < 5 -> flag low-engagement).

Sasha (CS): Love that. For renewals, add: capture NPS prompt at day 5, plus a one-click feedback link on failed responses. Helps capture qualitative reasons for churn risk.

Ben (SRE): From infra side: recommend customers set circuit breaker thresholds to avoid cascading retries. Our suggested k/v: 
```
circuit.breaker.error_rate: 0.05
circuit.breaker.window: 60s
retry.backoff: exponential(200ms, max 2s)
```
Also suggest limiting client-side concurrency to 50 requests/sec for initial ramp.

Ava (CS): Good call. I'll include a one-paragraph explainer about why batching reduces unit cost but increases tail latency - and the guidance to prefer small batches (<=8) for interactive apps.

Diego (Eng): One addition: include a quick command snippet customers can run to validate prefetch is working. E.g.:
```bash
# hit the prefetch endpoint with sample prefix
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefetch -d '{"prefix":"How do I"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY'
```
Reply with HTTP 200 and x-prefetch-cache: hit header = success.

Sasha (CS): For onboarding cadence: Day0 - ensure API key + example curl works. Day1 - enable prefetch + batching config. Day3 - validate streaming UX. Day5 - NPS + renewal signal capture. Day7 - health check + escalate if low usage. I'll make a one-pager for CSMs.

Ava (CS): I'm also adding a troubleshooting mini-section for common customer issues: 
- No prefetch hits -> check prefix tokenization and sample size (top5).
- High tail latency -> lower batch_size, enable async streaming where possible.
- Unexpected low engagement -> check session sampling and NPS prompts payload.

Ben (SRE): Add a note about telemetry endpoints customers should forward: request_id, latency_ms, model_variant, cache_status. Those fields let us triage renewal risk quickly.

Ava (CS): Will do. Last piece: short suggested email template for customers at day5 asking for feedback + link to self-serve warmup guide. Draft: 
"Hey {{name}}, quick 2-question check - did the assistant improve your workflow? (Yes/No) + any quick notes?"

Sasha (CS): Solid. Can we add an ops escalation pattern for high-risk renewals (<=3 NPS and <10 API calls/week) -> CSM + Solutions Eng + SRE triage within 48h?

Ava (CS): Yup - escalation step added. I'll update the doc and ping @here when it's in the enablement repo. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:

oncall-bot: Reminder: if you enable streaming in prod, file a short change note in the "streaming-features" channel so oncall is aware (automated follow-up in 24h).

Diego (Eng): Small nit: include example JSON for the renewal signal event we ingest (fields: customer_id, week_active_calls, nps_score, flagged_reasons). Helps analytics ingest quickly.

Ava (CS): Good. Adding that now and will share link to the GDoc here once ready.

Sasha (CS): Thanks - this should cut down the first-14-day churn by making onboarding prescriptive.

Ava (CS): Goal noted. Will track cohort 0 for 30 days and share results in the next enablement sync.
